body: Residual from index lane beamfall/corvint#1427. V1-1285 was closed as a dirty-worktree uncertainty issue (TCP-V0-141): the index was not stale. The lane still observed that a task text consisting only of a requirement ID (e.g. STR-V0-008) yields verdict no-specific-terms even though the spec routes that ID. Requirement IDs should count as specific terms.
